{{Quote|Then let the Core Worlds pay!|The individual|<ref name="Darth Plaguies">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
In [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], an '''individual''' was present in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Rotunda]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during a session of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], where they were seated below the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. When [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stated that the taxes required to create a military force would place too much of a burden on the outlying [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and thus lead to talks of secession, the individual shouted that the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] should pay instead. In response, the [[Unidentified Kuati senator (34 BBY)|Kuati senator]] said that the Core Worlds did not have a need for a military force as those in the Core lived in peace with one another.<ref name="Darth Plaguies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The individual appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plaguies" />
